title: JPM Market Data Snapshot
source_summary: Cross-provider snapshot for JPM built from Polygon, Tiingo, Twelve Data, and Alpha Vantage where available.
weaknesses: snapshot values can go stale quickly
providers differ in field coverage and definitions

fields.title: JPM Market Data Snapshot
fundamental_snapshot: alphavantage: revenueLTM=n/a, ebitdaLTM=n/a, netIncomeLTM=n/a, cash=n/a, totalDebt=n/a
provider_differences: alphavantage missing fields: marketCap, sharesOutstanding, revenueLTM, ebitdaLTM, netIncomeLTM, cash.
market_context: Primary quote consensus used polygon for directional context.
Fundamentals coverage came from alphavantage with explicit provenance.
analyst_relevance: Use provider-attributed snapshots to sanity-check price, market cap, and share count before running valuation models.
Treat provider disagreements as a prompt to confirm timing, endpoint definitions, and stale fields.
Keep quote provenance separate from fundamentals provenance in any downstream output.
